label: Fantasy Folk
description: The peoples of high and dark fantasy — elves, dwarves, orcs, fae and the rest. Described by build and bearing rather than by any one setting's lore, so they carry into whatever world the template is building.

items.name: high-elf
items.text: a high elf, tall and narrow-boned with long tapered ears, ageless features and a stillness that reads as patience rather than calm
items.text_short: tall narrow-boned high elf with tapered ears

items.name: wood-elf
items.text: a wood elf, wiry and weather-marked, leaf-cut hair and bark-toned skin, moving as though the ground were being asked rather than trodden

items.name: dark-elf
items.text: a dark elf, ashen-skinned with pale hair and reflective eyes, sharp-featured and dressed for places that never see the sun
items.text_short: ashen dark elf with pale hair and bright eyes

items.name: mountain-dwarf
items.text: a mountain dwarf, broad and short-limbed with enormous forearms, a braided beard weighted with rings and hands scarred by hot metal
items.text_short: broad mountain dwarf with a ringed braided beard

items.name: orc-warrior
items.text: an orc warrior, heavy-jawed and tusked, green-grey hide over slabbed muscle, war paint dried into old scar lines
items.text_short: tusked orc warrior, war paint over old scars

items.name: half-orc
items.text: a half-orc, human proportion carrying orcish weight, a slight underbite and grey-toned skin, watchful in the way of someone used to being read wrong
items.text_short: half-orc, human build carrying orcish weight

items.name: halfling
items.text: a halfling, small and round-cheeked with bare curled feet, practical layered clothes and an expression of unhurried competence
items.text_short: round-cheeked halfling with bare curled feet

items.name: fae-sprite
items.text: a fae sprite, palm-small and luminous, dragonfly wings blurring, trailing motes that go out slowly where they fall
items.text_short: palm-small luminous fae sprite, dragonfly wings

items.name: seelie-noble
items.text: a seelie noble of the fair court, impossibly symmetrical, antler-branched crown grown rather than made, beautiful in a way that asks to be looked away from
items.text_short: seelie noble with a grown antler crown

items.name: troll
items.text: a troll, hunched and enormous, hide like wet stone with lichen taking hold in the seams, small deep-set eyes under a heavy brow
items.text_short: hunched troll with stone-like lichened hide

items.name: frost-giant
items.text: a frost giant, three times a person's height, blue-white skin over a frame built for cold, rime in the beard and breath rolling out in sheets
items.text_short: blue-white frost giant, rime in the beard

items.name: merfolk
items.text: a merfolk of the deep shelf, iridescent scaling from the hips down, fin-veiled forearms and gill lines at the throat, hair moving as though still submerged
items.text_short: iridescent merfolk with gill lines and fin veils

items.name: centaur
items.text: a centaur, a human torso rising from a heavy-boned equine body, coat and hair matched, a bow slung across the human back
items.text_short: centaur, human torso on a heavy equine body

items.name: beastfolk-feline
items.text: a feline beastfolk, fur-patterned and digitigrade, rounded ears set high, slit pupils and a tail that finishes every sentence
items.text_short: digitigrade feline beastfolk with a telling tail

items.name: tiefling
items.text: a tiefling, warm-hued skin with swept horns and a slim tail, solid-colour eyes without a visible white, elegant and entirely unbothered by it

items.name: revenant-undead
items.text: a revenant, grave-pale and hollow-cheeked with a cold light behind the eyes, clothing that outlasted its wearer, moving with unhurried intent
items.text_short: grave-pale revenant with cold light in the eyes

items.name: vampire-noble
items.text: a vampire of old blood, bloodless complexion over aristocratic bone, immaculate high-collared dress and a stillness that never quite breathes
items.text_short: bloodless vampire noble in high-collared dress

items.name: werewolf-shifted
items.text: a werewolf mid-shift, a human frame lengthening into digitigrade legs, coarse pelt breaking through, jaw drawn forward and eyes gone gold
